blurb: Chandler's Landing Marina offers boat rentals including tritoons, wave runners, ski boats, kayaks, and paddle boards. The marina is located on Lake Ray Hubbard, a 22,745-acre reservoir with multiple boat launches and outdoor recreation opportunities. Guests can rent boats, join the Boat Club, or rent slips.

quotes.author: Aaron Sheffield
quotes.text: Management has really stepped it up this year, going above and beyond to take care of us on some mechanical problems on our lift and slip. New parking lot is nice. Best place to slip in Rockwall.

quotes.author: Ron Kanady
quotes.text: Very helpful and knowledgeable there services they provided I recommend chandler landing to everyone.

quotes.author: Mike Carter
quotes.text: I have rented a slip here for several years. Prices keep going down and quality of service going up!

quotes.author: Katie Seikel
quotes.text: We rented a boat from here recently and had a great experience. We will be back!

quotes.author: Joe Thacker
quotes.text: I have been going here 14 years, there is no other marina I would want to go to.

quotes.author: Preston Conner
quotes.text: I enjoy this place every time I go very peaceful and relaxing and good service.
